scope: Require current-tree Core inventory, lint, and checked JavaScript to pass before launching the full-history contract matrix. Preserve all twelve authenticated shards, their six-way concurrency cap, explicit budgets, aggregate closure, exact-head identity, and historical evidence. Keep exact-head hosted Core and the bounded hosted acceptance wave open.

edits.current:
# Static analysis reads only the exact current tree. Producer history is
          # deferred to the contract matrix after this gate succeeds.
          fetch-depth: 1
edits.previous:
# Evidence tests authenticate source bytes at their original producer commits.
          fetch-depth: 0

edits.current:
, source.replace("    needs: static\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04"
			, "    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04")
